description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of SimpleQA over the course of post-training, specifically showing the percentage of correct and not attempted answers at different stages. The horizontal axis represents the training stage, labeled “Base”, “SFT”, “DPO Stage 1”, and “Final”, in that order, and appears to be categorical. The vertical axis represents “Percentage (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. Each training stage has a stacked bar composed of three colored segments. The “Base” stage bar consists of a green segment representing “Correct” at 90.0%, a blue segment representing “Not Attempted” at 3.2%, and a light gray segment at 6.8%. The “SFT” stage bar consists of a green segment representing “Correct” at 57.5%, a blue segment representing “Not Attempted” at 3.7%, and a light gray segment at 38.7%. The “DPO Stage 1” stage bar consists of a green segment representing “Correct” at 79.8%, a blue segment representing “Not Attempted” at 2.9%, and a light gray segment at 17.4%. The “Final” stage bar consists of a green segment representing “Correct” at 81.1%, a blue segment representing “Not Attempted” at 3.0%, and a light gray segment at 15.8%. The bars are arranged sequentially according to the training stage, and the legend indicates that green represents “Correct”, blue represents “Not Attempted”, and light gray represents an unspecified category.
